_comment: Local addition (not part of the tool): ES2_SPAIN/SS4 Savalla, built like gr_ss3 (whole TrackSpline, prm road pieces only).
name: WrcgEsSS4
manual_notes: First asphalt port: 5,739 m, TARMAC 5,735 m (PM_SurfaceTarmacSmooth).
acr_surface / tyres (wr_fixes.py): variant surface, car setup and sectors Tarmac, tyres TarmacSnow (ACR's stock tarmac stages); the builder cloned Hafren South's Gravel / GravelOnly.
start: the grid node is ES2_SS4_Start_Pos (s 47 m), aliased to Start_Pos by wr_fixes.py; before, the stage started at s 0 with the start marshal 8 m from the car.
vegetation: WRCG's own instances replayed with the ES2_SPAIN rules of custom/data/wrcg_vegetation_map.merge.json (first guess).
crowd: ACR spectators on WRCG's PublicMA_* spots of SS4 (wr_crowd.py).
weather_distribution Greece / air 20 C: dry Mediterranean instead of Hafren's Wales / 5 C.

ground cover (owner drive, 2026-11-09: 'much more grass, plants and shrubs, like Alsace'; the few plants looked black): wr_groundcover.py, Munster densities on WRCG's grass layers, WRCG's own replayed grass dropped.
rvt: grass with Munster's RVT materials (owner: grass should take the ground colour, also for a snow version); RVT volume + RVT-only terrain copies with MI_Terrain9MatBlend1005 (wr_rvt.py).
finish marshal (owner: 'another marshal at the finish that stops the car'): Hafren's BC_StopMarshalEndSequence_C, raw export remapped (wr_finish.py).
crowd v2 (owner: spectators do not react / look the wrong way): characters face local +Y (was +X, 90 deg off), one id + crowd sound per spawner.

v4 (owner drive 2026-11-09): denser grass closer to the asphalt and following the slope; red flares in the crowd's front rows; night lights on the 7 MJ_STREETLAMP02 lamps (Monte Carlo's light-only blueprint); replay cameras tracking with tracked focus and zoom rebuilt for our distances; service park point turned 180 deg; skid decals in the corners (Munster's procedural asphalt skids). No bonfires: ACR has no fire/flame effect.

2026-11-15 (owner: Kenya's map is nearly optimal, enable the rest): auto_crowd, crowd_penalty and support_vehicles on as in ke_ss2; not enabled here: animals, road_tint/terrain_match, decals:false, ground_cover_pebbles (Kenya-specific). Untested on this stage.
